title.narrative: United Nations Team of Experts on the Rule of Law and Sexual Violence in Conflict: 2026-2030

description.narrative: Established pursuant to Security Council resolution 1888 (2009), the United Nations Team of Experts on the Rule of Law and Sexual Violence in Conflict supports national authorities in strengthening the rule of law and ensuring accountability for perpetrators of conflict-related sexual violence. The Team operates under a co-lead entity structure comprising DPO, OHCHR, SRSG-SVC and UNDP, with strategic leadership provided by the SRSG-SVC.From 2019 to 2025, the Team implemented the 2020–2024 Joint Programme, which was extended until 31 December 2025. Building on the achievements and lessons learned from this third iteration, the Advisory Group initiated the development of the next joint programme for 2026–2030. The overall approach and scope remain consistent, with updates to the context, theory of change and outputs based on independent review and consultations with co-lead entities.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
